note: The Star (2 May 2026): charges for first-time ID applicants have been removed, and the Registration of Persons (Amendment) Rules 2026 extend the waiver of fees for replacing lost or damaged cards and changing particulars from 30 April to 30 October 2026 (replacement isn't modelled). The age from which the card is issued (set by the Registration of Persons Act, which could not be read here), its term and the time weren't read.

sources.title: The Star (Kenya), State extends ID fee waiver by six months (2 May 2026)
sources.said: The government has extended the waiver on fees for the replacement of national identity cards and change of particulars for a further six months. ... The extension is formalised in the Registration of Persons (Amendment) Rules, 2026, ... Among these is the removal of charges for first-time ID applicants, as well as the scrapping of authentication fees for birth certificates.
